title: EXP-001 -- Existing Platform Commercialization
hypothesis: A previously built business platform (institutional site + blog), owner-provided and pre-existing, can act as an acquisition/content/lead-generation channel and a base for services or products that generate a return on the incremental capital the Capital Agent deploys into it, once the platform is production-ready and the human owner explicitly activates the experiment. This hypothesis is not declared true; it must be tested after activation.
lifecycle_note: lifecycle_state is the single source of truth for experiment state as of the editorial-platform-integration restructuring (see EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION.md). The legacy 'state'/'status' fields are kept in sync for backward compatibility with existing readers and must not diverge from lifecycle_state; new code should read lifecycle_state.

resource_budget.note: Non-financial resource budget, auxiliary only. operator_time_minutes is never auto-converted to money in the ledger or in ROIC (see INVESTMENT_POLICY.md and EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION.md).

non_financial_risks: reputational: content published under the owner's platform could misrepresent expertise or make unverifiable claims
privacy: mishandling of lead data collected by the platform could expose personal data
operational: dependency on a platform still being finished, with unknown reliability

activation.note: Status is PLANNED / NOT ACTIVATED. Do not infer activation from platform publication or from any technical milestone; only an explicit human activation record (see AI_OPERATING_MANUAL.md / CRITICAL_DECISIONS.md) may set activated=true and populate activation_date.

policy_issues: amount must be greater than zero -- expected while status=planned; no capital has been requested or deployed yet
success_metric: Not yet finalized. To be set in the activation package before the state can move to READY_FOR_ACTIVATION. Provisional candidates: verified qualified leads and/or verified attributable revenue within N weeks of activation (N to be fixed at activation time).
failure_criteria: Not yet finalized -- set at activation.
kill_condition: Not yet finalized. Provisional candidate: no verified lead or attributable revenue signal after a defined evidence window despite the platform being in production.
scaling_conditions: Not yet finalized -- set at activation, per INVESTMENT_POLICY.md section 6 (evidence-based scaling, not price/revenue alone).
review_frequency: Not yet finalized -- expected weekly once ACTIVE, per ROADMAP.md/config/schedules.json conventions.

domain.note: The owner acquires/renews the domain independently of the Capital Agent. Domain cost is never debited from the BRL 1,000 experiment capital, never counted in EXP-001 cost, and never used in EXP-001 or Capital Agent ROIC. See INVESTMENT_POLICY.md section 14 and ARCHITECTURE.md.

pre_activation_platform_costs.classification: PRE-EXISTING / OWNER-PROVIDED ASSET (sunk cost, external to the Capital Agent)
pre_activation_platform_costs.note: All platform development, infrastructure and tooling performed or paid before Capital Agent activation is a sunk cost belonging to the owner, not the experiment. Only capital committed after activation and meeting the incremental-cost test (INVESTMENT_POLICY.md section 14) may be attributed to EXP-001.

metrics.note: No data collected. Fields intentionally left empty/null rather than estimated -- do not fabricate analytics, leads, traffic or revenue before real instrumentation exists.

funnel_definition.note: Narrow initial economic mechanism per EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION.md / spec section 5.10. EXP-001 tests exactly one funnel, not simultaneous ads+affiliates+products+consulting+newsletter+SEO.
funnel_definition.roic_zero_capital_policy: If capital_deployed_brl == 0, ROIC is undefined (None), never infinite and never divided by zero -- see compute_roic() in src/business_integration.py. Use profit_brl, qualified_leads and attributable_revenue_brl as the primary signals instead.

missing: hypothesis is present but success_metric/failure_criteria/kill_condition are not finalized
resource_budget values are null (not yet estimated)
metrics_source not connected (platform has no sanitized telemetry export yet -- see backlog/platform-integration.md PLAT-001)
dev_prod_separation_confirmed is false (platform traffic-environment separation not yet available -- backlog PLAT-004)
publication_handoff_defined not finalized (Publication Receipt not yet producible by platform -- backlog PLAT-003)
open P0 backlog items: PLAT-001, PLAT-002, PLAT-003, PLAT-004
readiness_for_activation.note: Computed conceptually against src/business_integration.py check_ready_for_activation() preconditions during this session. EXP-001 remains PLANNED, not READY_FOR_ACTIVATION, because multiple P0 platform dependencies are open. See backlog/platform-integration.md.

revisions.change: Created as PLANNED/NOT ACTIVATED per the platform-integration restructuring (see SYSTEM_EVOLUTION.md and journal/reviews/platform-integration-restructure-readiness.md). No budget requested, no capital deployed, no activation date set. This record intentionally does not start the EXP-001 performance clock.

Migrated to the canonical experiment lifecycle schema (EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION.md / src/business_integration.py): added lifecycle_state (single source of truth, kept in sync with legacy state/status), capital_budget_brl, resource_budget (non-financial, operator_time_minutes never auto-monetized), non_financial_risks, a narrow single-funnel economic mechanism definition replacing any implicit multi-channel scope, and an explicit readiness_for_activation assessment.
